basics.name: Andy (Andrés) Menutti
basics.label: Creative Technologist · Audio Engineer · Full-Stack & AI Developer
basics.summary: Creative technologist with 25+ years in sound design and audio engineering (theatre, dance, film, live festival audio) and a deliberate move into full-stack and AI development. Builds audio systems that combine acoustic engineering, hardware integration and modern software (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, OpenAI and Anthropic APIs). Selected 1 of 300 from 32,000 applicants for the a16z × Y Combinator × Buildspace builder program.

work.name: OMNI (own project)
work.summary: Generative AI sound installation with custom ceramic speakers funded by Argentina's Fondo Nacional de las Artes.
highlights: Surface exciters in ceramic discs, ESP32 capacitive sensor arrays and a generative engine using OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.
Reliability planning for unattended public exhibition.
RIPPLE//OMNI permanent installation submitted to the Sónar+D / Fundación Cotec KNOWCASE Open Call 2027.

work.name: a16z × Y Combinator × Buildspace
highlights: 1 of 300 projects from 32,000 applicants; took OMNI from concept to a demo-ready build against weekly milestones.

work.name: Independent
work.position: Developer — MCP servers and AI-integrated tooling
highlights: MCP servers connecting Claude to Ableton Live (TypeScript) and the Akai MPC Live II (MIDI/USB).
OMNI Remote, a Next.js PWA for phone control of MPC and Ableton.
LLM apps for press management and political communication (Pressdiction, AgentMe).

work.name: Independent
work.position: Sound Designer / Live Audio Engineer / Studio Owner
highlights: Sound design, mixing and boom operation on 40+ films in Spain.
Composer and sound designer for 20+ theatre and contemporary dance productions; live sound design for Fuerza Bruta.
Live sound engineering at I Love Techno, Nature One and Awakenings.
Runs an audio studio in Buenos Aires and AMI Bookings, an artist management and booking agency.
